title: Three beats / a motion reference
creator: Field Notes Lab
summary: A small original study of arrival, alignment and rest. Watch the movement, read the timing, and keep your own observation.

transcript.title: Arrival
transcript.text: An orange marker moves from the left toward the first station on a line.

transcript.title: Alignment
transcript.text: The marker crosses the middle station while three pale circles settle into a row.

transcript.title: Rest
transcript.text: The marker reaches the final station. The circles remain in place for a quiet ending.

related.title: Room between objects
related.body: A row becomes easier to scan when its gaps follow a repeatable rhythm. Leave enough room to distinguish each object before using color or movement.

related.title: A response you can follow
related.summary: An original note on visible feedback.
related.body: Give each action a clear result. A paused movement should remain paused, and a failed copy action should offer a manual route instead of announcing success.

related.title: A quiet first frame
related.summary: An original note on motion restraint.
related.body: Start with a legible still image. Let the viewer choose to play, and keep a text description available when moving media cannot be loaded.
